summary: Personalis, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to announce that the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services expanded Medicare coverage for its NeXT Personal test to include immunotherapy monitoring for patients with late-stage solid tumors. This is a routine operational or regulatory update, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructurings, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or forced management changes. The announcement is a positive clinical/coverage development but does not trigger a special-situations category.
